Authors: Jiajun Zhu, Ying Zhang, Zhiqiang Zeng, Guangsheng Liu

Strain modulates bipolarized Weyl points in 2D d-wave altermagnetic Fe 2 I 2 and generates quantized Hall plateaus via symmetry reconstruction, offering a feasible route for topological quantum transport in 2D altermagnets.

DOI: 10.1039/d6nr02531e

item.title: Copper tungstate photoanodes: recent progress and prospects for efficient solar water splitting
item.description:
Authors: Kanishk Arunraj, Triet T. H. Nguyen, Pietro Ostellari, Francesco Lamberti, Enrico Della Gaspera

This review examines copper tungstate (CuWO 4 ) photoanodes for photoelectrochemical water oxidation, linking synthesis, defects, electronic structure and interfaces to performance, and assessing strategies and opportunities to overcome limitations.

DOI: 10.1039/d6nr03333d

Supramolecular precursor engineering can alter the formation pathway and electronic structure of carbon nitride materials.
